description: This file defines the AttributeCreatedStrategy class which handles AttributeCreated events in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for persisting attribute creation events related to 'things'. It extends an abstract event strategy and implements the logic to update a ThingBuilder with the created attribute.

classes.name: AttributeCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy for handling AttributeCreated events, applying changes to a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides method to apply an AttributeCreated event to a ThingBuilder by setting the respective attribute.
